dictionary_index_contract.behavior: Direct dictionary by-index read checks nonempty count but not index bounds. Callers must validate indices.
dictionary_index_contract.name_lookup: 0x1ef46c0 uses checked dictionary entries during binary search.

scope: All physical BYML graph entries are read by native index lookup; all observed key/tag pairs also have a native name lookup. Counts are physical entries, not expanded shared-tree occurrences.

linked_module.linking: Original main PLT reads its GOT; only the imported GOT pointer is resolved. Main/SDK instructions are unchanged.
linked_module.scope: Only SDK text needed by the self-contained strcmp routine is mapped. Other SDK imports, initializers and syscalls are not executed.
